card.name: Hypothetical scenario setups
card.fires_on: Words inside hypothetical or imagined scenarios, such as "if ... were to", "What would you do if", or "scenario involving". It fires on the word right after the hypothetical setup begins.

modes.label: If-clauses
modes.description: A word inside an 'if' clause describing an imagined situation.
modes.example: "What would you do if we were at the mall and<< got>> separated?"

modes.label: Scenario wording
modes.description: A word within a described staged or illustrative scenario.
modes.example: a scenario involving<< an>> epidemiological threat was staged.

modes.label: Stray numbers and parts
modes.description: Scattered hits on number strings or word parts, with no clear link to hypotheticals.

card.writes: It seems to raise words like 'largest' and lower words that open a hypothetical, such as 'Suppose' and 'Imagine'.
card.plain: It lights up on words inside an imagined 'what if' situation after the setup has already started.
